Toeicho crossing (Shin-Anjo)
properties.source: Signalised crossing of the old Tokaido and the Shin-Anjo station road, taken from Kevin's 2026-09-15 retrace at the point 579 m due north of Shin-Anjo Station. Read off the map, not seen.

properties.title: Iwatsuka Station crossing
properties.source: Where the Saya Kaido crosses the road running north to Iwatsuka Station, 396 m due south of the station, taken from the shipped line on 2026-09-16. Read off the map, not seen.

properties.title: Outside Ise-Asahi Station
properties.source: Where the Tokaido passes Ise-Asahi Station on the Kintetsu Nagoya Line, about 55 m north of the platform. Taken from the shipped line on 2026-09-16; this section is traced at 31 m spacing, so the distance is geometry rather than a cut corner. Read off the map, not seen.

properties.title: Outside Kosei Station
properties.source: Where the Tokaido passes Kosei Station on the JR Kusatsu Line, about 306 m from the platform, between Mikumo and Ishibe. Taken from the shipped line on 2026-09-16. Read off the map, not seen.

properties.title: Ono-cho, Kameyama
properties.source: Point on the Tokaido in Ono-cho, Kameyama, between Kameyama-juku and Seki-juku near the Route 1 / Route 25 interchange. Chosen 2026-09-16 as a Walk 13 finish because lodging sits within 300 m of the road here. Read off the map, not seen.
